title: Iris
description: Nine black anodised aperture blades over a mountain stream shot on 35mm film. Turn the ring from f/1.4 to f/16: the far bank stays sharp, and the sun glinting off the water in the foreground falls from nine-sided bokeh discs into 18-point stars. Every stop clicks into its detent and the blades swish as they close.
intent: One optical object finished to the edge: a real nine-blade iris whose opening is the shape of every bokeh disc and the source of every diffraction star, over a real film photograph, with the foley of a manual lens ring.
sources: Photograph: Kodak Lossless True Color Image Suite, kodim13 (mountain stream), a 35mm film scan from Kodak Photo CD PCD0992, released by the Eastman Kodak Company for unrestricted usage; via https://github.com/MohamedBakrAli/Kodak-Lossless-True-Color-Image-Suite (mirror of http://r0k.us/graphics/kodak/)
